title: Finite terminal extraction retains the square-root XOR loss
statement: The separately accepted physical-qubit output procedure resets actual targets, pauses nominal storage flips for a finite terminal window, then uses parallel bounded-strength two-site CNOT copying. Uniform port and target-reset laws on the SAME joint state give q_w=sqrt(p_port)+sqrt(r_reset) by commuting-projector Cauchy–Schwarz; independence is not claimed. The finite-cone perturbation moment/Markov estimate adds the stated incident-noise term. The terminal output targets are physical qubits, with no qualified detector/external software bit, post-copy storage retention or guaranteed resumed protected phase.
